name: shared-boundary-geometry-v1
lean: 12b338cc BoundarySharingAxioms, CM55 fixed complete affine expansion and CM51 normalized complex rows; finite witness, not float refinement or a guarantee of target correctness
input: The complete frozen319 original ordered records and fixed latent route extracted as in329. No task-name feature, generator rule, numeric raw-class feature, or original heldout query/label selection.
geometry: Two input-only frames: full grid; bounding rectangle of all cells outside the modal route block, with lowest block ID breaking count ties. Empty nonmodal rectangle refuses that family. In each frame and each block, use a constant1 plus minimum and maximum of either axis projections or axis and both diagonal projections. Divide each projection by its direction L1 norm. Empty blocks have zero descriptor rows. Geometry never reads record labels or their class numbers.
features: Same complete8-state normalized quadratic Fourier code as331: raw [1,u,v,u*u,u*v,v*v], L1-normalize by max(1,mass), pad to8, unitary DFT. A separate one-state block supplies the categorical common offset.
decoder: First-occurrence categorical raw labels in each fitting block, oriented by class centroid projection along one of the fixed16 directions inherited from331. More than two classes refuses a constructor. Empty blocks have zero logits; singletons have only their observed class offset. No label arithmetic is used.
sharing: Global complex alpha plus beta_b=sum_j eta_j descriptor_bj; beta_b/sqrt(8) is repeated in every real Fourier coefficient in block b. Minus/plus raw-class columns have opposite signed copies; both have a fixed common offset8 or32. The stored geometry is authenticated against the complete input route when fitting/replaying. No free block intercept remains.
budget: Complete per-class L1 radius1048576. Alpha weight=max binary class block occurrences. Eta_j weight=ceil(sqrt(8))*max_c sum over binary blocks containing c of abs(descriptor_bj). Fixed offset is common*max class block occurrences. Radial initialization and exact weighted Euclidean L1 projection charge this sufficient expansion bound. Independently audit all actual expanded columns/products.
initializer: Two no-CE-gradient constructors. Global uncentered quadratic-plus-descriptor ridge regression of categorical minus/plus signs; unlike331, block means are retained. Or fixed linear direction with each training block's strictly separating interval midpoint, falling back to its balanced class-centroid midpoint on overlap, then equal-block ridge regression of the negative boundary on descriptors. Ridges[1e-6,1e-4,0.01]. All16 directions, both frames, both banks, both constructors; gains[8,32,128,512], common offsets[8,32]. Complete3072 configurations,1152 fold states,9216 gain/common scores plus one full refit. Retain every failure, state and score.
selection: Three deterministic cell-hash folds, repeated cells stay together. Minimum pooled ordinary full-vocabulary CE, first configuration on exact ties, then refit on all training records. The inherited route uses all original training labels, so these are conditional head diagnostics and not an unbiased whole-model estimate. Retain the329 local control on identical folds and frozen331/332 complete references.
scope: Training-only task335 with all original records, actual short minibatches, zero CE gradients in forward mode, final iterates retained even on regression. Freeze before production. Task336 must separately freeze original35 scoring. Neither flatness nor successful fitting identifies unseen raw labels without a realizability/coverage premise.
